report:
The updated set supports explicitly narrated Experiment acquisition in three focal accounts: A04, A05 and A11, comprising six product acquisition/checkout/stock-up categories. A04 supplies four categories; A05 and A11 one each. These are source-account and category counts, not purchase-event or unit counts. The supplied input identifies only the updated stage; it does not identify the initial-stage membership or provide its saved diagnosis. Initial-stage counts, findings and changes therefore cannot be reliably reconstructed.

A04 describes buying Super Saturated after a sister’s introduction and positive experience, Buffer Jelly for greater nighttime hydration/repair, then face wash and mesh moisturizer amid enthusiasm for the line. A05 explicitly links instant Avant Guard checkout to TikTok discovery within a sustainability motivation. A11 explicitly stocked up on Softwear during months of loving it. Thus completed Experiment acquisition is independently repeated across three credited retailer-review origins, concentrated in one source role. Satisfaction-associated further acquisition recurs in A04 and A11; the specific products and reasons differ. There is no independently repeated precise product-specific buying reason or cross-role corroboration of completed focal acquisition. Reasons remain individual self-attributions, not established market causes.

A01 reports comment-driven cart readdition, not checkout. Its parent identifies Softwear and provides detailed praise, comparison with Eadem, and two backups attributed to love and previous access difficulty; that testimony belongs to context-only cowrunamuck. A02 reports routinely skipping the disliked-feeling Dr. Idriss exfoliator, as resolved by its parent, while liking the baste balm; it does not report Experiment avoidance. A12’s cream 2.0 and cleanser acquisitions concern Regimen Lab, with healing-moisturizer seeking after heavy tret use and prospective exploration of that brand. Neither supplies Experiment acquisition evidence.

The additions preserve materially different consequences: A14 received Buffer Jelly free and reports two uses mixed into nighttime moisturizer, not purchase or demonstrated repurchase. A15 considered returning Plasma Wash after severe eye burning and unsatisfactory cleansing/dryness, but reports no completed return. A16 intends Continuum to replace existing azelaic- and salicylic-acid products; actual replacement is not established. A04’s lack of further need for makeup remover is functional redundancy, not explicit completed discontinuation. A02 alone explicitly describes ongoing skipping of a routine product, scoped to Dr. Idriss.

Loyalty does not erase adverse outcomes. A11 reports dermatitis after months of Softwear use, prescribed steroid cream, recovery and a worse flare within 24 hours of retrying, alongside three unopened stockpiled tubes, a stated $70 CAD loss and continued qualified recommendation. The source attributes the reaction to Softwear; clinical causality is not independently established. A04’s favorable face-wash cleansing/hydration account and A15’s Plasma Wash account point in opposing directions, with exact face-wash SKU in A04 inferred from the supplied catalog and conditions differing. Softwear enthusiasm also coexists with A11’s delayed adverse experience. These performance findings are mixed; they do not negate the narrated acquisitions. Versions are unspecified, and most reasons, remedies and negative outcomes remain isolated reports.

Raw engagement: A01 Reddit score 13, A02 4 and A12 12, each supplied as material_positive=false and not interpreted. Every focal Junip review has 0 up-votes and 0 down-votes, with observation time unavailable. Context-only cowrunamuck has score 21 and RowanVC 42; neither score has sufficient supplied exposure/observation context for a materiality judgment. Scores are not verified experiences, independent actors, prevalence or buying effects. No focal bare agreement supplies additional purchase testimony.

Context is separately material: cowrunamuck praises Softwear’s smoothness, moisture and absence of scent, dislikes Eadem’s scent/taste, and reports two backups; RowanVC praises Softwear and Experiment generally while explaining Dr. Idriss layering with lanolin or another balm. Their identities are distinct from the focal Reddit actors, but all these lip-thread comments share one conversation and independent-origin credit for the Reddit records is unavailable. The two thread-opening posts supply reference context only; their actor identities and engagement are unavailable. Product pages and review metadata resolve targets and variants but add no acquisition testimony: A04’s Refill and A16’s First Time labels establish no extra action. A14’s explicit free receipt remains controlling despite metadata marked rewarded=false. Review update timestamps are not extra observations or events.

source_index.findings: boxybrown84, Reddit 1n9da6u, 2025-09-05: returned Experiment balm to FF cart explicitly because of the parent comment; Softwear resolved from context. No checkout, acquisition or use established. Score 13; material_positive=false, observation time unavailable. Parent cowrunamuck’s detailed experience and backups are separate context testimony, not A01’s. Formula/version unknown.

PamelaDamnela, Reddit 1n9da6u, 2025-09-05: has the referenced product but dislikes its feel and always skips it; likes baste balm. RowanVC’s parent resolves the skipped item to Dr. Idriss lip exfoliator, not Experiment. Explicit routine avoidance, no Experiment acquisition. Score 4; material_positive=false, observation time unavailable. Parent praise of Softwear and layering experience cannot be attributed to A02.

Junip customer 202931541, review 7540631, 2025-03-22, updated 03-23: four narrated Experiment acquisition categories—Super Saturated, Buffer Jelly, face wash (Plasma Wash inferred), mesh moisturizer (Molecular Mesh inferred). Sister introduction and liking Super Saturated precede own order; reports light, refreshing, fast-drying, non-clogging hydration before makeup. Bought Buffer Jelly for stronger nighttime hydration/repair, reporting glowy clean skin with a tiny amount despite initial oily/thick concern. Face wash reportedly removes makeup, hydrates and ends breakouts; moisturizer bought immediately at launch. Loves colorful packaging. No-more-makeup-remover-needed is functional redundancy, not explicit discontinuation. Refill metadata adds no repurchase assertion. Combo/sensitive metadata; versions unknown; votes 0 up/0 down, observation time unavailable.

Junip customer 44968672, review 1569510, 2022-11-03: explicitly instantly checked out reusable Avant Guard after TikTok discovery, within a sustainability goal after previously stopping near-nightly disposable sheet masks. One Experiment acquisition category. Near-perfect fit except cheek sides/nose, easy cleaning; motivates use of other hydrating/moisturizing products associated with barrier repair, so joint routine effects are unresolved. Metadata identifies Acid Lime/Small. No explicit completed substitution by this mask or repurchase. Votes 0 up/0 down, observation time unavailable.

eratch, Reddit 1i30kik, 2025-01-16: Regimen Lab scope resolved by thread title. Acquired cream 2.0 seeking a healing moisturizer after excessive tret and also cleanser; likes formulations and cleanser but calls cleanser small. Plans to try more, especially serums/moisturizers, with perceived science-based market-gap appeal. Other-brand acquisitions and intentions only. Score 12; material_positive=false, observation time unavailable; independent-origin posture unavailable.

Junip customer 178058824, review 6638709, 2024-11-25: one explicit Softwear stock-up category, leaving three unopened tubes and stated $70 CAD loss. Influencer recommendation preceded use; loved thick texture/sheen despite resistance and daily dead-skin removal. Reports delayed dermatitis, rough bumpy lips, prescribed steroid cream, recovery and worse flare within 24 hours of retry; attributes causality to Softwear without independent clinical confirmation. Still recommends trying it with caution, calls price reasonable and envies users who tolerate it. No completed return or refund reported. Sensitive-lip history denied despite combo/sensitive skin metadata; version unknown. Votes 0 up/0 down, observation time unavailable.

Junip customer 344086099, review 8950945, 2025-08-05, updated 08-20: explicitly free Buffer Jelly for honest review, not paid acquisition; only two uses reported. Rosacea account mixes a drop into nighttime moisturizer and reports soft skin without redness, irritation or clogged pores. Praises jelly-to-oil texture and silky slip; post-dermaplaning suitability and long bottle life are predictions. Initial small-bottle surprise reframed as reduced packaging/full 1 oz. Calls self an Experiment convert, without purchase commitment or action. Gift disclosure persists despite rewarded=false metadata; votes 0 up/0 down, observation time unavailable; version unknown.

Junip customer 210150638, review 6567933, 2024-11-04: Plasma Wash silky texture praised, but repeated wet/dry, amount and lathering variations reportedly fail to cleanse/foam, feel absorbed, burn closed eyes badly and leave skin less clean/moisturized than unnamed glycerin cleanser; double cleansing feels drier. Considered return only. Questions defect or technique in light of favorable social-media reports, which are not independently supplied testimony. Verified-buyer metadata alone adds no acquisition assertion. Combo/acne-prone metadata; version unknown; votes 0 up/0 down, observation time unavailable.

Junip customer 529373073, review 13599983, 2026-05-29, updated 06-11: Continuum use with light gel-serum texture, mild chemical smell, easy packaging and no sensitivity; praises parabens and perceived science-first formulation. Reports slightly less-red active acne overnight but explicitly cannot assess acne/pigmentation effectiveness objectively. Probably will replace regularly used azelaic/salicylic products for simplicity and become a staple; no completed replacement, narrated acquisition or repurchase. First Time/verified-buyer metadata adds none. Combo/acne-prone metadata; version unknown; votes 0 up/0 down, observation time unavailable.
